scope: LOCAL_PLAY_ONLY self-study fix; Steam verification and Steam-release parity are explicitly NOT goals. Fixes persistence (save/load) and Quit for non-Steam launch by switching Constants.USE_STEAM to false so the existing local File branch (user://_0_6_0.dat) is used.
